queries.sql: SELECT `students`.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(parents.fname, " ", parents.lname) SEPARATOR ", ") as parent_names, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT parents.phone SEPARATOR ", ") as parent_phones FROM `students` LEFT JOIN `student_parents` ON `student_parents`.`student_id` = `students`.`id` LEFT JOIN `parents` ON `parents`.`id` = `student_parents`.`parent_id` WHERE `students`.`id` NOT IN ('31') GROUP BY `students`.`id` ORDER BY `students`.`grade_section` ASC
